---
name: Instrument session result
about: Scoped physical observations, separate from accuracy qualification
---

Use only equipment you are authorized to operate. Stop on uncertain device state.
Do not change firmware, calibration storage or security settings to force a pass.
Read the instrument guide first. No physical session is required to report a bug.

Batches, transcripts, reports and bench folders may contain serials, operator
names, notes, sample labels, paths and confidential measurements. Share only a
minimal redacted COPY; keep originals. Do not post serials unless an agreed
private channel specifically needs them. Edited hash-bound records do not retain
their original authentication.

- Release/commit/checksum; native report identity; OS/architecture:
- Model/firmware (omit serial), mode, accessory, connection and physical context:
- Steps, expected/actual outcome and exact error:
- Cancellation/cleanup/save outcomes and final device state:
- Scope: physical session / Demo / substituted software (choose one):

A successful session is not accuracy certification or ArgyllCMS acceptance.
